subject: Re: Ephemeral evaluation provisioning and takedown plan
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@brightretail.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Exchange of eval materials — MAP and constraints

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BrightRetail is excited to run a short evaluation of Redwood’s runtime with a representative workload. To move to a scoped mutual action plan (MAP) we need a clear provisioning and takedown schedule plus usage constraints for the test materials (prompt packs, sample customer dialogs, and the test-case suite).

High-level asks from our side:
- Ephemeral access to a staging bucket (S3) or short-lived scp/rsync window — data must be gone within 45 days after handoff.
- Proof of deletion (S3 object lifecycle record or signed confirmation).
- No retention of PII; Redwood to confirm whether any internal telemetry will include raw examples.
- MD5 checksums for shipped prompt packs and a manifest of included files.

Can you propose a MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria (we expect basic throughput and latency gates + functional pass rate on the test cases)? We have Legal and Security standing by to sign a simple handover MPA if needed.

If you can draft something by COB Wednesday (11/11) we’ll review and return a few edits.

Thanks — attaching our security questionnaire for context (we’ll return it after you confirm the access model).

— Elena
Elena Garcia
Head of AI Partnerships | BrightRetail
elena.garcia@brightretail.com

Attachment: brightretail_security_qs.pdf
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@brightretail.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials — MAP and constraints

Elena — thanks, and really appreciate the clear asks.

I’ve attached an initial MAP (MAP_v0.1.pdf) that outlines a 4-step close timeline:
1) Access provisioning (ephemeral bucket + rbw-scoped credentials) — target 11/16
2) Seed data ingest and checksum verification — target 11/17
3) Evaluation run (7 day window) + acceptance criteria checks — window 11/17–11/24
4) Takedown & attestation (object deletion + audit log extract) — final by 12/01

We can accept the 45-day retention ask but ask for a firm end date so we can schedule automated destruction and export the audit evidence. We will not retain raw files beyond that window; telemetry will be aggregated metrics only unless you explicitly enable debug logging for a short troubleshooting window (we’ll require a signed exception).

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to send secure transfer instructions and the expected file manifest format.
- Marissa (Customer Success) to own the acceptance gating and runbook for the evaluation.
- Sign MAP_v0.1 and return redlines — we’ll update and move to DocuSign.

We’ll also include a promptpack sample (promptpack_sample-v2.zip) and a short transfer checklist.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachment: MAP_v0.1.pdf
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@brightretail.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:36:00 -0800
Subject: Transfer mechanics and manifest

Elena / team — quick technical note on the handoff so you can validate with infra/security: 

Transfer options (pick one):
A) Short-lived S3 pre-signed URLs (recommended) — we will provision a dedicated bucket with object TTL set to your requested retention and lifecycle rules to permanently delete after the takedown date. Pre-signed URLs expire after 72 hours and we will rotate credentials at handoff.
B) Secure scp to our ingress host (rbw-ingest.redwood.internal) — we’ll provide a one-time key and revoke it immediately after checksum verification.

Manifest format (CSV): filename, size_bytes, md5_hex, sha256_hex, description. Please include labels for any entries that contain anonymized PII so we can validate redaction steps.

Example file list we intend to send in promptpack_sample-v2.zip:
- prompts/checkout_abandonment_v1.json (120 KB)
- testcases/flow_57_convo.json (45 KB)
- metadata/manifest.csv (1 KB)

Checksums will be included in scp transfer and in the S3 manifest. Post-ingest we’ll run a content-scan to assert there is no raw PII; results will be shared to your security contact.

Attachment: scp_transfer_instructions.txt

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@brightretail.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, BrightRetail Legal <legal@brightretail.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials — MAP and constraints

Thanks Olga / Marcus — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A couple of quick notes from our Security & Legal: 

1) Retention: we would prefer 45 days post-handoff instead of 30 — are you ok changing the MAP to 45 days with a hard takedown deadline?
2) Redaction: BrightRetail will provide a redacted dataset and a labeled manifest. If Redwood finds any residual PII in the scan, we ask that you quarantine and notify us immediately; do not keep copies.
3) DocuSign: we’ll sign the MAP via DocuSign — please confirm the signatory and we’ll initiate.

We’re attaching the BrightRetail security questionnaire; please confirm the pre-signed S3 approach and we’ll share the redacted files by 11/16.

— Elena
Elena Garcia
Head of AI Partnerships | BrightRetail

Attachment: brightretail_security_qs.pdf
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@brightretail.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ephemeral evaluation provisioning and takedown plan

Elena — all good, we can accommodate 45 days. Final confirmations and next steps: 

- MAP_v0.1 will be updated to reflect 45-day retention and a takedown deadline of 2026-12-31; we will publish a signed attestation with object deletion receipts and S3 lifecycle logs.
- Signatory: Olga Petrov (Director, Solutions) — we’ll accept DocuSign and return the fully executed MAP within 24 hours of receiving the DocuSign envelope.
- Technical: Marcus to provision the pre-signed S3 bucket today and send the transfer manifest template.
- CS: Marissa will schedule the acceptance run and owns the acceptance checklist (throughput/latency pass criteria + functional pass rate >= 90% on provided testcases).

Tentative schedule:
- 11/14: Updated MAP and DocuSign envelope sent
- 11/16: BrightRetail uploads redacted promptpack (pre-signed URL)
- 11/17–11/24: Evaluation window
- 12/31: Final takedown and attestation delivered

Please confirm and we’ll move the DocuSign envelope into motion. Looking forward to a smooth short trial.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
